email.body1:
Garrett, saw VGV expanded into AI-native Flutter engineering and shipped a production app in 90 days with Claude workflows.

Moving into AI services usually surfaces more enterprise buyers than the BD team can reach, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for VGV off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Garrett, quick follow-up for VGV.

As the AI-native offering expands, the pipeline target tends to grow faster than the team can. Most BD leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings VGV needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Garrett, last bit of proof for VGV.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how VGV's reply rate likely compares to peer services and consultancy teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
